The domestic box office generated an estimated $124.05 million from Friday through Sunday, according to figures from Rentrak’s Paul Dergarabedian. That was up 9.1% from the previous weekend and 60.7% from the comparable weekend a year earlier. The top 10 films accounted for about $118.2 million of the total.

Box office running well ahead of 2025
The weekend extended a strong year for movie theaters. Domestic ticket sales have reached $7.79 billion through Sept. 27, up 19.1% from $6.54 billion at the same point in 2025, according to Rentrak.
